ra: Medaurus, rider-god of Risinium, belongs to the Illyrian pantheon hub.
Redon, sea/travel god of Lissus, belongs to the Illyrian pantheon hub.
Bindus, water-god of the Iapodes, belongs to the Illyrian pantheon hub.
Tadenus, local Dalmatian spring deity, belongs to the Illyrian pantheon hub.
Vidasus, woodland god of Topusko, belongs to the Illyrian pantheon hub.
Thana, hunt/woodland goddess of Topusko, belongs to the Illyrian pantheon hub.
Eia, north-Adriatic tutelary goddess, belongs to the Illyrian pantheon hub.
En/Enji, reconstructed Illyrian fire-god, belongs to the Illyrian pantheon hub.
Dei-Paturos, Illyrian-Thracian sky/father god, belongs to the Illyrian pantheon hub.
Sentona, Liburnian goddess of travel/wellbeing, belongs to the Illyrian pantheon hub.
Anzotica, Liburnian love-goddess of Aenona, belongs to the Illyrian pantheon hub.
Vidasus and Thana are regularly paired as a divine couple in the Topusko votive inscriptions.
Thana is the consort of Vidasus, paired together in the Topusko cult of woodland deities.
Eia and Sentona are linked in the north-eastern Adriatic (Histrian/Liburnian) votive record as associated goddesses.
Bindus is invoked in Iapodian inscriptions as Bindus Neptunus, an ancient interpretatio Romana identifying him with Neptune.
Vidasus is identified with the Roman/Italic Silvanus in the Topusko inscriptions, an attested interpretatio Romana of the woodland god.
Thana, the woodland and hunt goddess paired with Vidasus, is identified with the Roman Diana via interpretatio Romana.
